About the model

Model v2.4 · schedule board Tue Sep 15 10:18 PM CT · history through 2026-09-15 · 57,873 maps fitted · 479 teams · 2,467 players · market fit on 4,710 priced series.

Teams: Power is the one number. The model's own price on the Elo scale: 1500 is the average listed team, every 100 points is about 14 percentage points of map win probability against that average. Market-taught power, team Elo, player Elo, plus-minus and Weng-Lin (behind More columns) are inputs or cross-checks, not second opinions.

Players: Perf is the one number. The box-score composite the map probability is built from (kills, deaths inverted, economy-adjusted damage, KAST, opening kills, multikills per round), each in standard deviations against an average tier-S player over a 100-map half-life. +1.0 is a top-30 player, +1.3 the top 3. Plus-minus (rounds per map above an average player, teammates and opponents controlled) is the team-results check; it cannot separate players who always play together.

Schedule: times Central. Fair = the board's price (50/50 outcome-taught and market-taught; the lower of the two lineup prices when the roster is flagged). Edge = fair minus the price you would pay, in points; eROI = that edge over the price. Kalshi ask figures are after the taker fee; bid+1 figures are for a resting bid one cent above the current bid (no maker fee, fills only if someone sells into it). BET marks a side that meets betting rules v1:

What do these columns mean?
Startlisted start, Central time; the grey tag counts down. Tap a row for the detail line, tap a team for its card.
Tierbo3.gg tier the series is listed under
Bobest of N maps
Teamthe side this row prices; the opponent in grey
Fairthe model's chance for this team, with the fair American odds
PinnPinnacle's American line and its vig-included implied chance
K ask / K bidKalshi's book for this team, in cents
Pin edge / Ask edge / Bid+1 edgefair minus the price, in points: at Pinnacle's line, at the Kalshi ask after the taker fee, and one cent above the Kalshi bid
Pin eROI / Ask eROI / Bid+1 eROIthat edge divided by the price; BET = the side meets betting rules v1 (Ask = taker gate, Bid+1 = maker gate)
Max bidthe highest bid that still clears the 15% maker gate: what the bot will pay, and where to stop by hand
Sort / One side per seriesStart = time order, eROI = best first; one side per series keeps the better side of each series (the other side is in the detail line). The chips above the table are the five best bets in view; tap one to jump to its row.
Volcontracts traded on that Kalshi market so far
Notesroster flags, thin data, the lower-of-two-prices rule
